description: Runs the Android Automotive build of Google Maps (26.10.120003.E) on BYD DiLink 3 head units (Android 10) with MicroG-RE 7.3.0: sign-in, map, search, navigation and voice, UI density, language, driver side and color scheme settings, 3D buildings in the map layers, the main map's colors and layers on the cluster map where Maps shows one, the car's battery for EV routing (on by default on the tested BYD Dolphin and on BYD model ids 128 and 138) and the battery to arrive with at charging stops and at the destination, the battery percentage and energy model for Google Maps on your phone (on by default; a switch turns it off), Send to car from phone Maps with a car name you choose, an in-app problem report that is sent only after you review it, a daily check for a newer release, and a safe mode with feature switches. The app is named "Maps" unless you set another name in the App name option. BYD battery, Send to car, the BYD location flicker fix, BYD navigation volume and 3D buildings are separate patches. Requires Morphe Desktop 2.1.0 or newer.

patches.name: 3D buildings
patches.description: Adds Maps' own 3D buildings to the map layers. Google hides them in this app. The cluster map shows them only when you turn them on.

patches.name: Android 9 (API 28)
patches.description: Test builds for Android 9 head units (issue #11): lets the app install and start on Android 9. Tested on one Android 9 head unit; BYD head units do not need it.

patches.name: BYD battery (EV)
patches.description: Feeds the BYD battery into Maps' EV routing (battery on arrival, chargers). On by default on the tested BYD Dolphin and on BYD model ids 128 and 138, where owners' reports show it working; off with an "untested" notice on other BYD models and on DiLink 5. A Settings row turns it on or off and sets the battery to arrive with at charging stops and at the destination. By default Maps also sends the battery percentage and this car's energy model to your Google account, so Google Maps on your phone can show the battery; a switch there turns that off.

patches.name: BYD location flicker fix
patches.description: Holds back BYD's brief location off/on flips for up to 3 s, so Maps does not flash its location lockout.

patches.name: BYD navigation volume
patches.description: Plays Maps' spoken directions on BYD's navigation volume instead of the media volume.

patches.name: Google Maps Automotive for MicroG-RE
patches.description: Runs Google Maps for Android Automotive on Android 10 with MicroG-RE 7.3.0, named "Maps" unless the App name option says otherwise. Adds UI density, language, driver side and color scheme settings, a problem report, an update check and a safe mode. The cluster map uses the main map's colors and satellite layer.

options.description: The name in the launcher and the app list. Up to 30 letters, digits, spaces and - _ . ' & ( ) + ! : characters, starting with a letter or digit. The problem report's launcher entry is "Report" and this name. Phone Maps is called Maps too: pick Maps Car to tell them apart.

patches.name: Send to car
patches.description: Lets phone Maps send a trip to the head unit through MicroG-RE (push routes, the notification service identity and maps.app.goo.gl links). Adds a Send to car row in Settings: a status check and the car's name in phone Maps (default "Vehicle 1").

release_notes:
### New

- **Battery on the phone**, on by default: Google Maps on a phone signed in to the same Google account shows this car's battery ("Start with N%") and the battery on arrival. Maps sends your Google account the battery percentage every 2 minutes and again when it drops, and this car's energy model (without the battery level) when it starts and every 2 hours. A switch in the BYD battery dialog turns it off.
- **Cluster map**: If Maps draws a map on the instrument cluster, it gets the main map's colors and map layers (satellite, 3D buildings). Checked on a BYD Seal; the Dolphin's cluster doesn't show Maps. #13 by @paalkr.
- **Color scheme** has System, the head unit's own day/night mode. #14 by @paalkr.

Needs Morphe Desktop 2.1.0 or newer.

Tested on a BYD Dolphin (DiLink 3.0, Android 10) with Google Maps (Android Automotive) 26.10.120003.E and MicroG-RE 7.3.0. Other BYD models are untested, and BYD battery does not support plug-in hybrids (DM-i).

Setup: [README](https://github.com/fangkampanat/google-maps-automotive-patches#install).
